**Session summary: brain**

## Goal
Design exercise: a real-time management dashboard (Brain UI) for developers and project leads, grounded in the repo + tickets as the only source of truth. Persist the outcome in the existing #851 RFC and ship it.

## Instructions
- Another agent was working the memory area (#863, worktree brain-issue-863); never touch `.memory/` working-tree files in the main checkout.
- Design docs: local copy in ~/.claude/projects/-home-gandalf-IA-brain/design-docs/ first, repo copy only on explicit ask.
- No AI attribution trailers in commits (commit-msg hook refuses). Worktree per issue. Push/PR are Tier 2: ask first.

## Discoveries
- Only `brain:metrics --json` emits JSON; every other status/graph/board verb is prose. Structured data lives in pure functions: `status/epic-graph.mjs buildGraph()`, `lib/sdd-layout.mjs`, `status/derive*.mjs`, `review/lib/parse-verdict.mjs` + `board.mjs reconcileOnePr` + `queue.mjs gatherQueue`, `vcs/cli.mjs` port verbs, `.memory/records` jsonl, `resume-schema.mjs`, `status/release-debt.mjs`.
- Cold-review local artifact `openspec/reviews/pr-NNN/cold-review.md` is raw findings (`brain-findings/1`), removed before every run, gitignored, scattered per worktree. Only the latest verdict per PR is parseable; rounds live only in the forge comment timeline and the port has no comment-read verb.
- A verdict pins head_sha, so committing rev-N on the PR branch after APPROVE moves the approved head and is a foreign commit (ADR-0026 Am.5). Review history must ride the #862 memory lane.
- PR from a branch behind main shows CONFLICTING on GitHub even when the local merge is clean: `.memory/index.jsonl` has no merge driver and `manifest.json` uses a custom driver GitHub lacks. Fix: merge origin/main locally in the worktree and push the merge commit. The post-merge hook rewrites index.jsonl to include hydrated uncommitted records; restore it to HEAD before pushing.
- The pre-push hook hydrates engram into the worktree's `.memory/` (untracked records + modified index/manifest). Do not commit those on a feature branch.

## Accomplished
- Rulings by maintainer: (1) cold-first cut implied; (2) review-round history committed and shared, local uncommitted state as an overlay; (3) verdicts become `.memory/records` with new `type: review`, riding the #862 lane, emitted by poster.mjs at post time.
- Amended the #851 RFC (docs/inbox/visual-task-graph-and-realtime-dashboard.md): audiences + rule zero, three-tier state model with measured inventory, prerequisite data work (review records, ADR parser, anti-pattern index, roadmap = epic graph, `brain:snapshot --json`), MCP last, HTTP+SSE server, management views, 7-slice roadmap.
- PR #873 opened, conflict resolved via merge of main, all gates green, MERGED as 0fcc94d5 on 2026-09-08.
- Handoff comment posted on #863 (issuecomment-5587568834). #863's PR #875 merged right after.
- Local design doc: design-docs/brain-ui-state-inventory-2026-09-06.md. Engram topic keys: design/brain-ui-state-inventory, design/brain-ui-review-history, review/local-artifact-persistence, design/brain-ui-rfc-pr.

## Next Steps
- Slice 1 (review records) depends on #862 lane decision and the `review` type promotion into memory-format.md (Tier 2). Check whether #875's landed contract lists the review poster as a producer.
- Slice 2 (read model + `brain:snapshot --json`, ADR parser, anti-pattern enumerator) has no dependency and could be filed as its own issue.
- RFC open questions §8: read-model transport, spec renderer, ADR data source (parse vs authored blocks).
- Worktree brain-issue-851 still exists with 7 untracked hydrated records; branch merged.

## Relevant Files
- docs/inbox/visual-task-graph-and-realtime-dashboard.md — the RFC, Amendment 1 (merged)
- brain/scripts/review/lib/findings-artifact.mjs, run-cold-review-stage.mjs — local artifact contract and per-run removal
- brain/scripts/review/poster.mjs — future emission point for review records
- brain/scripts/status/epic-graph.mjs — buildGraph(), the roadmap skeleton
- ~/.claude/projects/-home-gandalf-IA-brain/design-docs/brain-ui-state-inventory-2026-09-06.md — inventory + rulings
